about: Every dated official record the app holds for 2026, newest first: Council's legislation (dated by its latest dated action), the meetings on the Clerk's calendar, and the roll calls the City Record prints. Each row names its source and when that source was pulled. Words are the record's own. A ward tie says why: the title names the ward, the ordinance text ties ward money to it, or an address in the title is in the ward. Sponsorship is not a vote, and a missing record is not a no. Nothing is ranked or scored.
